_comment: A family names the flashers that may write it, checked when the config loads. A family with no flashers is a board nothing can write, discovered at flash time; an unknown flasher name is a typo that silently drops a device from every provider's targets(). What is deliberately NOT guarded here is a misspelt or missing helper: a misspelt one raises from helpers.for_name at the point a capability is asked for, not on the shared typelist.load path, so one typo costs a row rather than the whole panel - and a family with no helper at all is valid for every builder, with the accessors answering None for it.

mutations.name: a family with no flashers is refused
mutations.find: no_flashers = [family for family in families.values() if not family.flashers]

mutations.name: an unknown flasher name is refused
mutations.find: family.name: [name for name in family.flashers if name not in firmware.FLASHERS]
mutations.replace: family.name: [name for name in family.flashers if False]

mutations.name: the flashers list is read from the section
a bootloader family is suggested its ROM flashers
a helper without a capability does not get offered as one
mutations.find: return helper if isinstance(helper, BootselRequester) else None
